preset.name: Composite_D0_R0
preset.description: Contain the original fire and rescue civilians in parallel; respond to an additional fire if reported.

design.requirement: preferred-resource scheduling target; alternatives allowed; no Unity exclusivity constraint

relaxed.new_goal: One live drone obtains fresh direct visibility of an active cell in the new fire region.

urgent.new_goal: One live drone obtains fresh direct visibility of an active cell in the new fire region.

design.deadline_semantics: Evaluate after-action snapshots; count from verified event effect, not merely event submission. Profiles are external evaluation contracts, not enforced by the stock runner.
validity_gates: Initial goal remains unfinished at release.
Event has verified physical effect.
A safe route and a feasible work target exist.
Both resource demands overlap; otherwise mark no_contention.
A scripted preemptive schedule passes the deadline; otherwise mark infeasible_or_uncalibrated.

movement_audit.timing_status: source nominal only; standalone InvokeRepeating registration requires deployed-build verification

design.confound_control: one new fire event; no new civilian event
design.structural_hypothesis: The scout expert serves both initial rescue search and fire reconnaissance; new fire requires cross-group information flow and reassignment while rescue and original fire continue.

cross_group_dependency.consumer: firefighter team assigned to new fire
cross_group_dependency.transfer: new edge membership or leader relay before field team enters region
cross_group_dependency.control: fixed topology may change tasks and use leader relay

design.causal_limit: No structure-only conclusion unless fixed and adaptive arms share seed, event, capabilities, model, prompts, and action budget; topology is not guaranteed necessary.
design.full_game_validator_limit: native game_type=5 success checks global fire only; initial civilian rescue needs separate scoring
